thread:
Anya: heads-up — ran a quick cross-region perf sweep for Qwen-24B (rope+GQA) on A100 vs H100 vs Mi250 in eu-west vs us-central. results look...messy. posting raw notes.
Vikram: nice, can you paste the command and target config?
Anya: sure — single-shot perf harness we used:
```
./bench --model qwen-24b --rope true --gqa true --seq 2048 --batch 8 --quant 4 --kernels auto --warmups 50 --iters 200
```
Anya: configs: A100 (n1-highmem) in us-central, H100 (a2) in eu-west, Mi250 in eu-west. same AMI, driver 535, cudnn pinned. kernel selection left to runtime.
Jamie: do you have latency p50/p95 and tokens/s?
Anya: pasted CSV (col:region,gpu,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_per_s):
```
us-central,A100,38.2,76.9,625
eu-west,H100,33.5,120.1,710
eu-west,Mi250,45.9,89.4,540
```
Maria: H100 p95 looks high — maybe kernel fallthrough for long seqs? we've seen slower tail when kernel picks naive attention for GQA+rope combos.
Omar: did the runtime fall back to CPU kernels or to a slower kernel path? any kernel logs?
Anya: yes, I grabbed runtime logs — there were a couple of "fallthrough: kernel not available for seq=2048 -> using generic_attn" entries.
Vikram: that would explain H100 p95 spike. generic_attn on long seqs + dynamic batching causes tail. Can you check kernel registry for that model variant?
Anya: checked: qwen-24b-rope-gqa combo has optimized fused_kv_attn for H100 but our build was missing the AVX fallback for the Mi250 so Mi250 used slower path. H100 fallthroughs correspond to a missing tiled_attention patch in the region image.
Jamie: interesting that H100 had better p50 but worse p95 — suggests cold-starts / uneven batch packing. What's the inter-arrival distribution used?
Anya: synthetic tracer used Poisson lambda=25 rps per worker. We saw occasional bursts causing larger batches triggering the slower kernel.
Maria: on the quant front, did you test int4 vs int8? quant 4 might amplify kernel variance if quant kernels aren't implemented for tiled_attention.
Anya: ran int4 and int8 quick compare (same run but change `--quant`):
```
A100 int8 p95 72.1 tokens/s 640
A100 int4 p95 81.3 tokens/s 680
H100 int8 p95 118.6 tokens/s 710
H100 int4 p95 145.2 tokens/s 735
```
Anya: int4 improved throughput but also increased p95 variance on H100 — looks like quantized kernels are faster but their fallback paths are more brittle.
Omar: from an infra perspective, we should pin kernel sets per region image. If H100 in eu-west doesn't have tiled_attention v2 we should push a quick patch or route to A100 fallback pool.
Vikram: agreed. two action items: (1) reproduce minimal repro with single-threaded tracer to isolate batching effect, (2) align kernel builds across images and add a unit test that asserts fused_kv_attn present for qwen-24b-rope-gqa.
Jamie: I'll sketch the perf dashboard tiles: p50/p95, tokens/s, kernel-fallthrough-rate, quant-mode. link when done.
bench-bot: deploy-check complete — ami-2026-02-12-eu-west image missing tiled_attention_v2 (detected via registry check) :warning:
Maria: notes on quality/regression: we ran 100 eval prompts across quant4 and quant8 — small degens in int4 for specific long-context arithmetic prompts (rope position sensitivity). filing an eval ticket.
Anya: filing infra ticket and adding the minimal repro gist: https://internal.gists/r/xyz123 — gist contains the harness + steps to reproduce fallthrough.
Omar: for capacity sizing: given tokens/s numbers and 99th shard safety buffer, we recommend reserving 20% more slots for H100 eu-west until tiled_attention fixed.
Vikram: also add a canary rollout for kernel patch: canary 5% -> monitor kernel-fallthrough-rate drop and p95.
Jamie: will add chart and alert thresholds (p95 > 100ms in eu-west for qwen-24b -> page oncall).
Anya: thanks — I'll coordinate the kernel patch and re-run the sweep. cc @Omar for reservation change. :thumbsup:
Omar: acknowledged, changing reserved capacity for next billing cycle.
Anya: follow-up: re-run scheduled tomorrow 04:00 UTC with tiled_attention_v2 in eu-west image, will post fresh numbers.
Vikram: perfect. if anyone wants to pair on the minimal repro ping me. :mag:
